args: Analyze the root cause and best minimal fix for MqttClient_PacketReset in wolfmqtt/src/mqtt_client.c around line 1040. Specifically determine which MQTT packet structures place a MqttPendResp immediately after MqttMsgStat under WOLFMQTT_MULTITHREAD, whether MqttConnectAck does so, and whether reset should skip the pending-response prefix based on packet type or some other discriminator.

The reported sanitizer crash occurs in a WOLFMQTT_V5 + WOLFMQTT_MULTITHREAD build. MqttClient_WaitType resets the shared client->msg union before decoding CONNACK. The report says MqttClient_PacketReset always adds sizeof(MqttPendResp) to an offset already past MqttMsgStat, leaving MqttConnectAck.props stale when CONNACK has zero property length; Handle_Props then frees the bogus pointer. A reference search in the current tree surprisingly reports a pendResp member associated with MqttConnectAck in wolfmqtt/wolfmqtt/mqtt_packet.h around line 415, so macro layout/conditional compilation and packet-specific structure details need careful examination before patching.
